# Table.ToColumns

```m
Table.ToColumns(table as table) as list
```

Creates a list of nested lists of column values from a table.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/table-tocolumns)
